question: Which of the following business scenarios represents the strongest use case for Prompt Builder?
options: Automatically scoring inbound leads based on demographic and behavioral signals.
Routing incoming service cases to the correct support queue based on case category.
Drafting a personalized follow-up email to a customer after a support case is resolved.
explanation: El uso principal de Prompt Builder es generar contenido en lenguaje natural a partir de datos estructurados. Redactar correos personalizados de seguimiento es un ejemplo perfecto de esta capacidad.

question: Coral Cloud Resorts (CCR) sees the agent forgot the dietary/activity preferences gathered earlier. They need those preferences to persist throughout the session. What should CCR implement?
options: Configure custom variables to capture/store customer preferences from action outputs.
Rely on natural conversation memory and instruct the agent to look back.
Create a context variable to capture/store customer preferences as action outputs.
explanation: Las variables personalizadas (custom variables) permiten capturar y almacenar preferencias del usuario a lo largo de la sesión para que el agente acceda a ellas.

question: Medical Devices Inc. configured a new document ingestion process in Data Cloud for PDF files, set up field mappings, and created the search index. When configuring the retriever, the team notices a required field is missing from the available options. How should Medical Devices Inc. resolve this issue?
options: Modify the search index configuration to include the missing field.
Update the retriever settings to add the missing field directly.
Create a calculated field in the Data Cloud data model that derives the missing value.
explanation: El índice de búsqueda define qué campos están disponibles. Si falta un campo en el 'retriever', se debe modificar la configuración del índice de búsqueda para incluirlo.

question: When configuring a file-based data library for an agent that processes engineering specifications, what are the maximum allowed file sizes for DOCX files and PDF files, respectively?
options: Up to 3 MB for DOCX files and up to 75 MB for PDF files
Up to 4 MB for DOCX files and up to 100 MB for PDF files
Up to 10 MB for both DOCX and PDF files
explanation: Para una Data Library basada en archivos, el tamaño máximo permitido es de 4 MB para archivos DOCX y 100 MB para archivos PDF.

question: Universal Containers (UC) plans to answer questions based on similar cases that have been successfully resolved in the past. What should UC consider when implementing this approach?
options: No action is needed, as past cases are used to answer the question.
Create a data model object (DMO) based on Case object and create an index on it.
Create an unstructured data model object (UDMO) based on Case object and create an index on it.
explanation: Como Case es un objeto estructurado (DMO) estándar en Data Cloud, se debe crear un índice de búsqueda directamente en sus campos de texto.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to implement an AI-powered customer service agent that can: Retrieve proprietary policy documents that are stored as PDFs. Ensure responses are grounded in approved company data, not generic LLM knowledge. What should UC do first?
options: Set up an Agentforce Data Library for AI retrieval of policy documents.
Expand the AI agent's scope to search all Salesforce records.
Add the files to the content, and then select the data library option.
explanation: El primer paso es configurar una Agentforce Data Library para recuperar los documentos. Esto permite cargar e indexar los PDFs para fundamentar las respuestas de la IA.

question: Universal Containers wants to implement a customer verification process where sensitive account information can only be accessed after the customer passes identity verification. The agent must enforce this security rule deterministically without allowing the LLM to bypass the verification requirement. What should an Agentforce Specialist recommend as the best solution?
options: Use context variables to store verification status in the messaging session and configure the agent to check these variables through natural language prompts during each sensitive action.
Include detailed verification instructions in the agent's topic instructions explaining when customers should be verified and rely on the LLM to follow these guidelines consistently.

Create a custom variable IsCustomerVerified set by a verification action, then apply a conditional filter using the expression IsCustomerVerified equals true to all sensitive data actions, ensuring deterministic access control that the LLM can't alter.
explanation: Crear una variable personalizada y filtros condicionales asegura un control de acceso determinista para acciones sensibles. Depender únicamente de las instrucciones del LLM no garantiza el cumplimiento estricto.

question: Before activating a custom agent action, an AgentForce Specialist would like to evaluate multiple real-world user utterances to ensure the action is being selected appropriately. Which tool should the AgentForce Specialist recommend?
options: Testing Center
AgentForce Builder
Prompt Builder
explanation: El Testing Center permite evaluar múltiples expresiones reales de usuarios para validar el comportamiento del agente. Proporciona un entorno detallado para pruebas basadas en escenarios antes de la implementación.

question: An Agentforce Specialist needs to create a prompt template that extracts the customer's name, phone number, and case number from a block of text, and nothing else. How should the Agentforce Specialist structure the prompt to ensure the large language model (LLM) doesn't include extra conversation or text?
options: Ask the LLM to extract and only output the important information in the text.
Use well-defined output instructions and provide desired output examples.
Ensure in the prompt that the LLM has been told to only use name value pairs in the response.
explanation: Para garantizar que el LLM extraiga información precisa sin añadir texto extra, se deben proporcionar instrucciones de salida claras y ejemplos del formato esperado. Esto guía al modelo para devolver únicamente datos estructurados.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is implementing generative AI and wants to leverage a prompt template to provide responses to customers that gives personalized product recommendations to website visitors based on their browsing history. Which initial step should UC take to ensure the chatbot can deliver accurate recommendations'
options: Design universal product recommendations.
Write a response scrip for the chatbot.
Collect and analyze browsing data.
explanation: El primer paso para ofrecer recomendaciones personalizadas es recopilar y analizar los datos de navegación del usuario. Sin esta información, la IA carece de contexto para sugerir productos relevantes.

question: An Agentforce Specialist is creating a prompt template to assist support reps in drafting responses to customer complaints. To ensure the responses are empathetic and helpful, what is a key element to include in the prompt template?
options: direct instruction to the large language model (LLM) to role-play as a character
list of keywords related to customer complaints
The entire history of the customer's previous interactions with the company
explanation: Usar la técnica de 'Role-Playing' instruye al LLM a adoptar un personaje específico. Así, la IA puede actuar como un representante empático al responder quejas de clientes.

question: An Agentforce needs to create a Sales Email with a custom prompt template. They need to ground on the following data. Opportunity Products Events near the customer Tone and voice examples How should the Agentforce Specialist obtain related items?
options: Call prompt initiated flow to fetch and ground the required data.
Create a flex template that takes the records in question as inputs.
Utilize a standard email template and manually insert the required data fields.
explanation: Un flujo iniciado por prompt recupera datos dinámicamente de registros relacionados para dar contexto a la salida generativa.

question: A music streaming service deployed a Service Agent handling playlist recovery, account cancellation, and audio quality settings. After updating the Account Cancellation subagent instructions to include a retention offer flow, some cancellation questions started routing to the Playlist Recovery subagent. The team needs to diagnose the regression before full deployment. Which approach is most systematic and objective?
options: Run the stored test suite in Testing Center against the modified agent, review Subagent Pass % metrics to identify regressions, then add test cases for the retention flow.
Ask three support agents to manually test 20 conversation paths each and report misrouting.
Deploy to 5% of production users and monitor the misrouting rate in the observability dashboard for two days.
explanation: Testing Center ejecuta pruebas programáticas e identifica regresiones objetivamente mostrando reducciones claras en el porcentaje de aprobación por subagente.

question: An Agentforce Specialist is tasked with analyzing Agent interactions, looking into user inputs, requests, and queries to identify patterns and trends. What functionality allows the Agentforce Specialist to achieve this?
options: Agent Event Logs dashboard.
AI Audit and Feedback Data dashboard.
User Utterances dashboard.
explanation: El panel de expresiones de usuario (User Utterances) está diseñado específicamente para agregar y analizar las solicitudes y conversaciones de los usuarios.

question: A call center implements AI-generated work summaries to help agents quickly document customer interactions. After each conversation, the system automatically populates summary information. Besides the conversation summary, what additional information does the AI generate to help agents understand the context of the interaction?
options: Customer satisfaction score prediction and sentiment analysis results.
The problem described by the customer and the solution provided during the call.
A draft follow-up email template for the agent to review and send.
explanation: Además del resumen, la función AI Work Summaries genera automáticamente la descripción del problema (issue) y la solución proporcionada (resolution).

question: TechSolutions Inc. needs to monitor and analyze complete interaction logs for all customer service conversations handled by their AI agent. Which tool should TechSolutions use to obtain comprehensive visibility into the agent's decision-making process throughout each conversation, including the logic applied, actions performed, data passed to and from prompts and decision points, system errors encountered, and the ultimate reply delivered to customers?
options: "Conversation Analytics".
Session Trace, capturing a complete end-to-end record of the agent's behavior including reasoning engine decisions and all inputs/outputs.
"Agent Performance Dashboard".
explanation: Session Trace captura un registro completo del comportamiento del agente, incluyendo las decisiones del Reasoning Engine, entradas, salidas y errores.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants its AI agent to return responses quickly. UC needs to optimize the retriever's configuration to ensure minimal latency when grounding AI responses. Which configuration aspect should UC prioritize?
options: Increase the recency bias setting for the retriever limiting scope to more recent data.
Ensure the retriever’s filters are defined to limit the scope of each search efficiently.
Configure the retriever to operate in dynamic mode so that it modifies the search index structure at runtime.
explanation: Aplicar filtros eficientes acota el alcance de la búsqueda y reduce el volumen de datos a procesar. Esto minimiza directamente la latencia al acelerar el escaneo del índice y la recuperación del contexto necesario para el grounding.

question: In which scenario would implementing a Data Cloud retriever be appropriate?
options: Synchronizing updated customer records back to the original source system after processing.
Retrieving semantically relevant information from the vector database to enhance an AI prompt through retrieval-augmented generation.
Extracting data from external websites in real-time during a conversation.
explanation: Un 'retriever' se utiliza específicamente para buscar información relevante en la base de datos vectorial y enriquecer el prompt mediante Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

question: Universal Containers implemented Agentforce for its users. One user complains that an Agent is not deleting activities from the past 7 days. What is the reason for this issue?
options: Agentforce does not have the permission to delete the user's records.
Agentforce Delete Record Action permission is not associated to the user.
Agentforce does not have a standard Delete Record action.
explanation: Agentforce no cuenta con una acción estándar incorporada (por defecto) para la eliminación directa de registros.

question: A business stakeholder wants to use AI to generate a summary based on Data Cloud data. Which method(s) should the stakeholder use to access Data Cloud data from Prompt Builder?
options: Accessing data model objects (DMOs) directly in Flex templates, using Data Cloud related lists, and fetching Data Cloud data using prompt-initiated flows
Using Data Cloud related lists and fetching Data Cloud data using prompt-initiated flows
Using only external APIs to import Data Cloud data into Prompt Builder
explanation: Para acceder a datos de Data Cloud desde Prompt Builder se pueden usar DMOs en Flex templates, listas relacionadas y flujos iniciados por prompt. Estas opciones ofrecen flexibilidad y son complementarias.

question: An auto parts retailer has a knowledge base with articles categorized by vehicle type (Car, Truck, Motorcycle). They want the agent to retrieve only Car articles. What does enabling "Filter by Knowledge Data Categories" do in a knowledge-based data library?
options: It adds the selected category names as metadata tags to each article to improve search ranking.
It limits the indexing process to include only articles assigned to the selected categories, excluding all others from retrieval.
It creates separate vector indexes for each category and searches them in parallel.
explanation: Filtrar por categoría de datos restringe desde la indexación los artículos admitidos, de modo que el contenido fuera de esa categoría no pueda ser recuperado.

question: Sales representatives at Technology Solutions spend significant time reviewing customer histories and past communications before sending follow-up emails about renewals and upsell opportunities. Which standard agent action helps representatives create personalized outreach emails based on previous successful customer interactions?
options: Draft or Revise Sales Email.
"Generate Email from Template".
"Compose Personalized Message".
explanation: La acción estándar 'Draft or Revise Sales Email' crea borradores de correos electrónicos de ventas personalizados basándose en interacciones previas.

question: Universal Containers is using Agentforce for Sales to find similar opportunities to help close deals faster. The team wants to understand the criteria used by the Agentforce to match opportunities. What is one criteria that Agentforce for Sales uses to match similar opportunities?
options: Matched opportunities are limited to the same account.
Matched opportunities were created in the last 12 months.
Matched opportunities have a status of Closed Won from last 12 months.
explanation: La acción 'Buscar oportunidades similares' analiza oportunidades en estado 'Closed Won' de los últimos 12 meses en toda la organización.

question: An Agentforce Specialist is creating a custom action for Agentforce. Which setting should the Agentforce Specialist test and iterate on to ensure the action performs as expected?
options: Action Instructions
Action Name
Action Input
explanation: Las 'Action Instructions' (Instrucciones de Acción) le dicen al LLM cómo y cuándo utilizar la acción. Iterar sobre ellas es vital para asegurar que el agente entienda cuándo lanzarla.

question: An Agentforce Specialist is setting up a new org and needs to ensure that users can create and execute prompt templates. The specialist is unsure which roles are necessary. Which permission sets should be assigned?
options: Prompt Template Manager for creating templates and Prompt Template User for executing templates.
Prompt Template Manager for creating templates and Data Cloud Admin for executing templates.
Data Cloud Admin for creating templates and Prompt Template User for executing templates.
explanation: El conjunto de permisos **Prompt Template Manager** otorga la capacidad técnica de diseñar y administrar plantillas de prompt, mientras que **Prompt Template User** habilita los permisos de ejecución para utilizarlas. Asignar ambos cubre exactamente el ciclo completo de creación y uso requerido.

question: A support manager at Global Financial Services notices that their AI assistant sometimes selects the wrong troubleshooting steps or fails to complete customer requests. They need to investigate these issues by reviewing detailed records of all customer interactions with the assistant. Where should the support manager navigate to access comprehensive data about every user conversation, including instances where the assistant made errors, selected incorrect processes, or failed to complete requested tasks?
options: "Agent Configuration Panel".
Interaction History Logs, containing complete records of all user exchanges, system errors, misrouted requests, and unfinished workflows.
"Workflow Designer".
explanation: Los Interaction History Logs (o Event Logs) contienen registros completos de las conversaciones, errores y flujos no terminados. Es el lugar adecuado para investigar fallos y analizar el comportamiento del asistente.

question: An Agentforce turned on Einstein Generative AI in Setup. Now, the Agentforce Specialist would like to create custom prompt templates in Prompt Builder. However, they cannot access Prompt Builder in the Setup menu. What is causing the problem?
options: The Prompt Template User permission set was not assigned correctly.
The Prompt Template Manager permission set was not assigned correctly.
The large language model (LLM) was not configured correctly in Data Cloud.
explanation: El especialista necesita el conjunto de permisos Prompt Template Managers para acceder a Prompt Builder. El permiso de usuario solo permite usar plantillas, no crearlas ni administrarlas.

question: Universal Containers plans to enable Agentforce in Slack so teams can interact with agents directly in Slack channels. Which description represents the key steps required to enable Agentforce in Slack?
options: Enable the default Slack channel Agentforce, and assign Slack agent access to users.
Configure the Slack workflow to invoke the Agentforce API, enabling users to interact with agents through predefined triggers and automated steps,
Configure the Slack agent connection and, in Manage Agentforce, install the agent, then assign agent access to users.
explanation: La integración requiere configurar la conexión de Slack, instalar la aplicación Agentforce en el espacio de trabajo y asignar permisos a los usuarios.

question: An Agentforce Specialist wants to troubleshoot an agent that is hallucinating weblinks. The agent has an action that uses a prompt template, which is using a knowledge retriever, to generate the output text. Which process is appropriate to find the root cause of the hallucination behavior?
options: Examine the topic name and classification description for hallucination guardrails.
Examine the prompt instructions and contents of the chunks shown in the resolved prompt output.
Examine the topic instructions and ensure the word 'ALWAYS' is used in the hallucination guardrails.
explanation: Para identificar la causa de alucinaciones con enlaces web, se deben revisar las instrucciones del prompt y el contenido de los fragmentos (chunks) resueltos. Esto permite determinar si el error proviene de los datos fuente o del LLM.

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) is deploying two agents simultaneously: an internal Sales Productivity Agent for employees and a customer facing Service Agent on its Experience Cloud site. An Agentforce Specialist is configuring permissions and needs to understand the correct security context for each. Which statement accurately describes the execution model?
options: The customer-facing Service Agent inherits the security context of the Experience Cloud site's guest user profile by default, requiring guest profile object permissions to be configured for all actions the agent executes.

The internal Sales Productivity Agent executes actions using the authenticated Salesforce employee's own permissions, while the customer-facing Service Agent executes actions as a dedicated Einstein Service Agent User with its own permission set.

Both the internal Sales Productivity Agent and the customer-facing Service Agent execute actions as a dedicated Einstein Service Agent User with its own permission set that is configured as required for the agent.
explanation: Los agentes internos operan con los permisos del empleado autenticado, mientras que los de cara al cliente usan un perfil dedicado (Einstein Service Agent User).

question: Coral Cloud Resorts (CCR) uses Agentforce to assist customers with booking and service issues. CCR wants to implement a triage process so that: • High severity requests must be escalated to a human service rep. • Lower severity requests should result in creating a support case for the guest. • The requirement is to achieve the highest reliability and determinism in the response from the agent. Which approach should an Agentforce Specialist recommend?
options: Write the triage and routing logic in Topic Instructions using an IF, THEN, ELSE pattern: "Escalate to human service rep if the request is considered severe, otherwise create support case".
Use absolute keywords like "Always" and "Never" in Topic Instructions to enforce logic, such as "Always escalate when severity is high" and "Never create a support case when severity is high".

Create a custom variable severityLevel populated by a Triage action. Add filters so the "Escalate to human service rep" action only runs when severityLevel = 'High', and the "Create Support Case" action runs only when severityLevel != 'High'
explanation: Se debe utilizar una variable personalizada para almacenar el estado de severidad y aplicar filtros condicionales en las acciones. Este método garantiza un enrutamiento determinista, evitando depender de la interpretación del LLM.

question: Universal Containers wants to reduce overall agent handling time by minimizing the time spent typing routine answers for common questions in-chat, and reducing the post-chat analysis by suggesting values for case fields. Which combination of Einstein for Service features enables this effort?
options: Einstein Service Replies and Work Summaries
Einstein Reply Recommendations and Case Summaries
Einstein Reply Recommendations and Case Classification
explanation: Reply Recommendations sugiere respuestas para el chat y Case Classification sugiere valores para los campos del caso post-chat.

question: Based on the user utterance, “Show me all the customers in New York”, which standard Agent action will the planner service use?
options: Select Records
Query Records
Fetch Records
explanation: La acción estándar 'Query Records' es la encargada de buscar y listar múltiples registros en base a una condición (ej: clientes en New York).

question: A developer migrating from the legacy builder mindset writes "@topics.returns" in Agent Script to reference the returns flow and gets an unknown-reference error. What is the correct reference?
options: @subagent.returns — valid references are @variables, @actions, @subagent (singular), @outputs and @utils.
@subagents.returns, using the plural form.
topics.returns, without the @ prefix.
explanation: El término heredado 'topics' fue reemplazado por 'subagents', y las referencias en el código deben utilizar la forma singular. El prefijo @topics ya no existe en el lenguaje.

question: Universal Containers declares "session_id: linked string = 'TBD'" with a source mapping and gets a compile error. What is wrong?
options: Linked variables get their value exclusively from their source and cannot declare a default value.
Linked variables must also include the mutable keyword.
String defaults require double quotes instead of single quotes.
explanation: Las variables tipo linked son de solo lectura y obtienen su valor exclusivamente de su fuente original. No pueden declarar un valor por defecto ni combinarse con la palabra clave mutable.

question: Ursa Major Solar is building its first agent with Agent Script in Agentforce Builder. A developer declares a variable in the variables block as "discount_count: mutable number" but the script fails to compile. What is the cause of the error?
options: Mutable variables must declare a default value, for example: discount_count: mutable number = 0.
The number type is not supported for variables; the developer must use string instead.
Variables can only be declared inside a subagent block, not at the top level.
explanation: En Agent Script, todas las variables mutables deben declarar un valor por defecto para poder compilar. number es un tipo válido, y las variables se declaran en el bloque superior.

question: A pharmaceutical company needs their assistant to provide researchers with current drug interaction guidelines from approved clinical documents. Updates to guidelines must be reflected immediately without manual intervention. What should they implement?
options: Configure the assistant to search all clinical trial data and research papers for relevant interaction information.
Set up an Agentforce Data Library to store, index, and retrieve clinical guideline documents for AI grounding.
Manually update prompt templates with new guideline information whenever documents are revised.
explanation: Agentforce Data Library indexa y actualiza automáticamente el contenido sin intervención manual. Esto garantiza que las directrices clínicas estén siempre al día, a diferencia de otras opciones menos escalables.

question: Which business requirement presents a good use case for leveraging Einstein Prompt Builder?
options: Forecast future sales trends based on historical data.
Identify potential high-value leads for targeted marketing campaigns.
Send reply to a request for proposal via a personalized email.
explanation: Enviar una respuesta personalizada a una solicitud por correo electrónico es un caso de uso óptimo para las capacidades generativas de Einstein Prompt Builder.

question: A medical lab must ensure its support agent always provides the most current version of testing procedure documents. Outdated content could lead to incorrect diagnoses. What should the specialist recommend?
options: Connect a knowledge-based data library to Salesforce Knowledge, which automatically retrieves only the published version of each article using native version control.
Store all procedure files in a file-based data library and manually delete old versions each time a new one is uploaded.
Add a "valid until" date field to each document and instruct the agent in its system prompt to ignore documents past that date.
explanation: Una biblioteca basada en Knowledge usa el control de versiones nativo para que el agente recupere invariablemente las políticas en su versión publicada actual.

question: What is an AI Specialist able to do when the “Enrich event logs with conversation data" setting in Agentforce is enabled?
options: View the user click path that led to each Agentforce action.
View session data including user Input and Agentforce responses for sessions over the past 7 days.
Generate details reports on all Agentforce conversations over any time period.
explanation: Habilitar esta opción permite ver los inputs del usuario y respuestas del agente de los últimos 7 días.

question: A nonprofit organization uses a small development team that works exclusively with declarative tools. They need an AI agent that can prepare staff for donor meetings by summarizing giving history, highlighting interests indicated by website activity (tracked in Data Cloud), and recapping previous email and phone conversations. What approach should the consultant recommend?
options: Build and deploy a custom fine-tuned model on the organization's donor data using Einstein Studio.
Create a prompt template grounded in CRM and Data Cloud data using standard foundation models.
Implement a third-party AI service with custom API integration.
explanation: Una plantilla de prompt fundamentada en CRM y Data Cloud permite resolver este caso usando únicamente herramientas declarativas estándar.

question: When an authenticated premium member says, "I need to upgrade my current service tier," an AI assistant must: validate member status, calculate applicable discounts, generate a new service quote, and route to a relationship manager only if the annual value exceeds $50,000. Which assistant type should be configured to handle this complete customer-facing workflow?
options: Service Assistant, to manage the end-to-end member interaction and create appropriate sales records for follow-up.
Sales Assistant, to focus on the upselling opportunity and handle high-value escalations directly.
Commerce Assistant, to process the transaction and manage payment collection.
explanation: Para flujos de trabajo orientados al cliente que implican soporte o gestión de cuentas, como cambiar de plan, un Service Assistant es la opción más adecuada. Este agente gestiona la interacción y escala la solicitud según umbrales de valor.

question: Universal Containers recently launched a pilot program to integrate conversational AI into its CRM business operations with Agentforce Agents. How should the Agentforce Specialist monitor Agents' usability and the assignment of actions?
options: Run Agent Analytics
Query Agent logs via Metadata API
Use Platform Debug Logs
explanation: Use Agent Analytics para monitorear la usabilidad de los agentes y la asignación de acciones.

question: Sales reps at Universal Containers should not be able to create or edit prompt templates. Which permission set should an Agentforce Specialist assign to the sales reps?
options: Prompt Execute User
Prompt Template Manager
Prompt Template User
explanation: El conjunto de permisos Prompt Template User permite solo ejecutar plantillas existentes, sin poder crearlas o editarlas. Es ideal para usuarios finales que no requieren gestionar los prompts.

question: An Agentforce Specialist at SunVista Hotels is tasked with building an AI agent to handle guest dissatisfaction cases automatically. The agent should be capable of offering room upgrades, dining credits, and complimentary amenities. When a guest experiences a severe service failure — such as an overbooking — the agent must escalate the case to a live representative. Per Salesforce best practices, which agent type should the specialist deploy?
options: Agentforce with a Sales prompt template.
Employee Agent with a structured topic configuration.
Service Agent with a Flex prompt template.
explanation: El Service Agent está diseñado específicamente para atención al cliente y puede manejar quejas o escalamientos. Combinado con un Flex template, permite generar respuestas de compensación dinámicas y personalizadas.

question: Universal Containers (UC) has recently received an increased number of support cases. As a result, UC has hired more customer support reps and has started to assign some of the ongoing cases to newer reps. Which generative AI solution should the new support reps use to understand the details of a case without reading through each case comment?
options: Agentforce
Einstein Sales Summaries
Einstein Work Summaries
explanation: Einstein Work Summaries resume automáticamente el historial del caso para que los representantes entiendan rápidamente los detalles.

question: A national utility company's customer agent has been running for six weeks. The observability dashboard shows the "Billing Dispute" intent cluster has low quality, with the reason "ambiguous subagent match." Session traces confirm the planner routes billing disputes to the "Payment Arrangement" subagent on most turns. What is the most effective solution?
options: Reduce the number of subagents from 10 to 4 by merging billing and payment intents into a single subagent.
Rewrite the classification descriptions of the two overlapping subagents to eliminate semantic confusion and create clear boundaries.
Add a system instruction that says "Never send billing disputes to payment arrangement subagent" and place it in every subagent's prompt.
explanation: Reescribir las descripciones de clasificación de los subagentes para que sean mutuamente excluyentes previene la confusión semántica y soluciona el mal enrutamiento.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is creating a new custom prompt template to populate a field with generated output. UC enabled the Einstein Trust Layer to ensure AI Audit data is captured and monitored for adoption and possible enhancements. Which prompt template type should UC use, and what additional configuration is required?
options: Sales Email, and that the object is associated with a campaign.
Field Generation, and that Dynamic Forms is enabled.
Record Summary, and that the Lightning page is updated to Dynamic Forms.
explanation: Para rellenar campos con salidas de IA, se debe usar el tipo de plantilla Field Generation y habilitar Dynamic Forms en la página.

question: Universal Containers' administrator has developed a new agent in a sandbox environment and now wants to deploy it to production. What should the administrator do to deploy an agent?
options: Export agent components as JSON files and manually import them into production using the Metadata API.
Create an outbound change set with all the necessary agent components, then upload to production.
Manually recreate the agent configuration, topics, and actions in production because change sets cannot be used.
explanation: La configuración completa de un agente, incluyendo temas y acciones, representa metadatos nativos de Salesforce. El método oficial para migrarlo a producción es mediante un conjunto de cambios saliente (outbound change set).

question: An Agentforce wants to include data from the response of external service invocation (REST API callout) into the prompt template. How should the Agentforce Specialist meet this requirement?
options: Convert the JSON to an XML merge field.
Use External Service Record merge fields.
Use “Add Prompt Instructions” flow element.
explanation: Para inyectar datos de una llamada REST en un prompt, se utiliza el elemento de flujo 'Add Prompt Instructions'.

question: What is best practice when refining Agentforce custom action instructions?
options: Provide examples of user messages that are expected to trigger the action.
Use consistent introductory phrases and verbs across multiple action instructions.
Specify the persona who will request the action.
explanation: La mejor práctica es proporcionar ejemplos de los mensajes del usuario que deberían disparar la acción.

question: Universal Containers (UC) wants to implement an Al-powered customer service agent that can  Retrieve proprietary policy documents that are stored as PDFs.  Ensure responses are grounded in approved company data, not generic LLM knowledge. What should UC do first?
options: Add the files to the content, and then select the data library option.
Expand the Al agent's scope to search all Salesforce records.
Set up an Agentforce Data Library for AI retrieval of policy documents.
explanation: El primer paso es configurar una Biblioteca de Datos (Data Library) o índice vectorial en Data Cloud. Esto permite fundamentar las respuestas del agente en los documentos PDF.

question: Universal Containers wants to use an Al agent to answer questions about warranties, Warranty information has already been uploaded as unstructured data in Data Cloud. When answering user questions, the results must be filterable by product line and ranked by recent updates. Which approach should the Agentforce Specialist implement?
options: Use the default retriever which automatically accounts for regency ranking.
Build a custom retriever in Einstein Studio with product line filters and regency ranking.
Apply semantic embeddings with default metadata filters to achieve the desired result
explanation: Se debe construir un recuperador personalizado (Custom Retriever) en Einstein Studio. Esto permite aplicar filtros específicos de metadatos y lógica de clasificación, como por línea de productos y antigüedad.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is setting up a new Agentforce Service Agent. The company has sensitive medical product research stored internally and wants to ensure the agent cannot access it. What should UC do?
options: Assign the Agentforce Service Agent user the lowest possible role in the organization's hierarchy to block access.
Disable the Agentforce Service Agent's ability to use any Salesforce custom object or related fields.
Follow the principle of least privilege and avoid granting permission to view the Medical Product object or related fields.
explanation: Se debe seguir el principio de mínimo privilegio y no otorgar al usuario del agente acceso al objeto Medical Product ni a sus campos. Esto garantiza que la información confidencial quede restringida.

question: Where should the AI Specialist go to add/update actions assigned to a Agentforce ?
options: Agentforce Actions page, the record page for the Agentforce action, or the Agentforce Action Library tab
Agentforce Actions page or Global Actions
Agentforce Detail page, Global Actions, or the record page for the Agentforce action
explanation: Las acciones de Agentforce se gestionan desde la página de Acciones, la página del registro de la acción o Action Library.

question: Coral Cloud Resorts wants the "checkout" tool of its booking agent to be offered to the LLM only when the shopping cart has items. Which syntax is valid in reasoning.actions?
options: available if @variables.cart_has_items == True
available when @variables.cart_has_items == True
require @variables.cart_has_items == True
explanation: En el bloque reasoning.actions, la condición de guardia correcta se escribe usando 'available when' seguido de la expresión condicional. Esto determina de forma estricta si la herramienta se ofrece o no al LLM.

question: Universal Containers recently added a custom flow for processing returns and created a new Agent Action. Which action should the company take to ensure the Agentforce Service Agent can run this new flow as part of the new Agent Action?
options: Assign the Manage Users permission to the Agentforce Agent user.
Assign the Run Flows permission to the Agentforce Agent user.
Recreate the flow using the Agentforce Agent user.
explanation: Para que el Agente pueda ejecutar un Flujo, su usuario subyacente debe tener asignado el permiso explícito de 'Run Flows'.

question: Universal Containers needs to provide insights on the usability of Agents to drive adoption in the organization. What should the Agentforce Specialist recommend?
options: Agent Analytics
Agentforce Analytics
Agent Studio Analytics
explanation: Agentforce Analytics proporciona paneles e informes específicos para medir la adopción, el uso y el rendimiento general de los agentes.
